alphabet_caption: Point to each letter until students guess: C is for Crocodile!

story.short_summary: The class explores a swamp where they meet Colin the Crocodile.
story.call_and_response_note: Children repeat the key phrase chorally when Colin appears.
story.full_story_speaker_notes: [TEACHER NAME] starts the adventure in the swamp. 'Look! I see something green and scaly!' Suddenly, Colin the Crocodile peeks out of the water. 'Hello, I'm Colin!' he says with a big smile. [TEACHER NAME] asks, 'What do you like to do, Colin?' Colin replies, 'I love to swim and snap my big jaws!' The children join in, saying, 'Snap, snap, crocodile!' [TEACHER NAME] encourages, 'Let's all build our own Colin the Crocodile!'
observation_questions: What color is Colin the Crocodile?
How many legs does Colin have?
